limitations: Actual mean cadence is not a hard real-time deadline guarantee; physical dt follows measured wall time.
About 3 Hz IK is a target. Real received half-speed control updates measured 2.46/2.49 Hz during motion; full per-channel rates are recorded.
All acquired raw images/IMU/commands are archived; inference fuses only explicitly selected latest captures. Archived is not assimilated.
Displayed predictions lag physical pose. Observation, prediction and physical timestamps/commands are distinct and disclosed; final drain reaches zero lag.
Neither case reaches the 6mm physical requirement. No collision detected in either 30-second run.
Absolute pose overconfidence is not resolved. Neither final physical hand error is within the 95% Gaussian proxy region; trajectory coverage counts are descriptive, not calibration guarantees.

Marker-relative observations may permit common body/environment error. User common-shift interpretation is structural; direction/amount of upward absorption and full causal attribution are not proved by this run.
Gravity IMU constrains tilt, not yaw or absolute translation directly.
This natural half-speed run reacquires before a complete search roundtrip. Amplitude expansion and cap-repeat are unit/synchronous-historical evidence, not newly exercised async behavior.
